content: 第二关（后）

raw: Oh... Rosmontis, what are you doing?
content: Oh... Rosmontis, what are you doing?

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  I... I wanna fix this terminal.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: I... I wanna fix this terminal.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  Six years of memories up to last year... I saved them all in here...
speaker: Rosmontis
content: Six years of memories up to last year... I saved them all in here...

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  This morning, I went to read the log from June 12, but the screen wouldn't turn on.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: This morning, I went to read the log from June 12, but the screen wouldn't turn on.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  What if... what if I can't ever read them again...?
speaker: Rosmontis
content: What if... what if I can't ever read them again...?

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  The March 14th log, when I went to the botanical gardens with daddy, or hiking in July, or the time when mommy...
speaker: Rosmontis
content: The March 14th log, when I went to the botanical gardens with daddy, or hiking in July, or the time when mommy...

speaker: Rosmontis
content: ...Mommy...

raw: D- don't cry! Listen, you're not great with screens, right?
content: D- don't cry! Listen, you're not great with screens, right?

raw: Why not wait until Scout can help you fix it? Or Closure?
content: Why not wait until Scout can help you fix it? Or Closure?

raw: I'll take it to Closure for you. She'll fix it up lickety-split!
content: I'll take it to Closure for you. She'll fix it up lickety-split!

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Scout...

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  Is Scout that one operator who moves around all quiet?
speaker: Rosmontis
content: Is Scout that one operator who moves around all quiet?
That's him! You know him?

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Yeah.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  With that perfectly polished look... like a porcelain doll.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: With that perfectly polished look... like a porcelain doll.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: There he is.
Huh...?

raw: [name="Scout"]  I had yet to hear your estimation of me. I now understand how weak it is.
speaker: Scout
content: I had yet to hear your estimation of me. I now understand how weak it is.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.4, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: When did you get here?!

raw: [name="Scout"]  You could say I have always been here. I am used to concealing myself.
speaker: Scout
content: You could say I have always been here. I am used to concealing myself.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  So Mr. Scout was here all along.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: So Mr. Scout was here all along.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Why didn't Blaze sense it?

raw: I... I wasn't paying attention. I just didn't notice!
content: I... I wasn't paying attention. I just didn't notice!

raw: Hey, if you were standing here all this time, why didn't you help her fix it?
content: Hey, if you were standing here all this time, why didn't you help her fix it?

raw: [name="Scout"]  Forgive me. We are mere moments from undertaking a mission. I must focus my energy on calibrating my weaponry.
speaker: Scout
content: Forgive me. We are mere moments from undertaking a mission. I must focus my energy on calibrating my weaponry.

raw: [name="Scout"]  You might ask Closure, or the good Mechanist to assist you.
speaker: Scout
content: You might ask Closure, or the good Mechanist to assist you.

raw: Are you about to go save Dr. {@nickname}?
content: Are you about to go save Dr. {@nickname}?

speaker: Ace
content: Yes.
Oh. You're going too.

raw: [name="Ace"]  It's me we're talking about. If I didn't go, what kind of joke would Rhodes Island's elite operators be?
speaker: Ace
content: It's me we're talking about. If I didn't go, what kind of joke would Rhodes Island's elite operators be?

speaker: Scout
content: And what did Ascalon say?

raw: [name="Ace"]  The usual. She's not going. Always there with Kal'tsit, that one.
speaker: Ace
content: The usual. She's not going. Always there with Kal'tsit, that one.

raw: [name="Scout"]  Did it ever occur to you... That now is perhaps not the optimal time?
speaker: Scout
content: Did it ever occur to you... That now is perhaps not the optimal time?

raw: [name="Ace"]  But it might be our last chance.
speaker: Ace
content: But it might be our last chance.

raw: [name="Ace"]  Chernobog is probably going to turn back deep into Ursus to avoid that Catastrophe. And a rescue operation in the Ursus interior is going to be damn near impossible.
speaker: Ace
content: Chernobog is probably going to turn back deep into Ursus to avoid that Catastrophe. And a rescue operation in the Ursus interior is going to be damn near impossible.

raw: I keep hearing you talk about it, but is this Dr. {@nickname} really worth all this?
content: I keep hearing you talk about it, but is this Dr. {@nickname} really worth all this?

raw: [name="Ace"]  Worth as much as Amiya and Kal'tsit.
speaker: Ace
content: Worth as much as Amiya and Kal'tsit.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Have I met the Doctor?

raw: [name="Ace"]  Not yet. But you will soon.
speaker: Ace
content: Not yet. But you will soon.

raw: [name="Rosmontis"]  Good. I want to know what the Doctor is like too.
speaker: Rosmontis
content: Good. I want to know what the Doctor is like too.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: I really, really want to.

speaker: Scout
content: You will, kitten.

raw: By the way, Ace, there's an uninfected girl named GreyThroat on your team.
content: By the way, Ace, there's an uninfected girl named GreyThroat on your team.

raw: [name="Ace"]  I'm aware. She's been training in isolation.
speaker: Ace
content: I'm aware. She's been training in isolation.

raw: [name="Ace"]  Listen, Blaze. I've been working with her for a few months now. She has trouble expressing herself, but she's not a bad person.
speaker: Ace
content: Listen, Blaze. I've been working with her for a few months now. She has trouble expressing herself, but she's not a bad person.

raw: She looked my teammate in the eye and asked, 'How hard could it be to be Infected?'
content: She looked my teammate in the eye and asked, 'How hard could it be to be Infected?'

raw: [name="Ace"]  I know. But it might have been a legitimate question to her. She might really be curious.
speaker: Ace
content: I know. But it might have been a legitimate question to her. She might really be curious.

raw: [name="Ace"]  It's not my place to demand an operator turn her opinion on a dime. And GreyThroat has never once questioned orders.
speaker: Ace
content: It's not my place to demand an operator turn her opinion on a dime. And GreyThroat has never once questioned orders.

raw: I don't care. I'm not going to stand by and let her insult my teammates, and I sure as hell won't let her disgrace the struggle of the Infected.
content: I don't care. I'm not going to stand by and let her insult my teammates, and I sure as hell won't let her disgrace the struggle of the Infected.

raw: [name="Ace"]  Now's not the time. I can see the rage you're holding back. But really, not now.
speaker: Ace
content: Now's not the time. I can see the rage you're holding back. But really, not now.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.4, xstrength=10, ystrength=12, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=true)]
She said it right in front of me!
content: She said it right in front of me!

speaker: Scout
content: Take a breath, Big Cat.

raw: [name="Scout"]  You have a task at hand yourself.
speaker: Scout
content: You have a task at hand yourself.
...I do.

raw: Fine. We'll deal with it when you get back.
content: Fine. We'll deal with it when you get back.

raw: Since when is Ace more senior than me?
content: Since when is Ace more senior than me?

raw: [name="Ace"]  When you take that tone, I start to think maybe you're screwing around.
speaker: Ace
content: When you take that tone, I start to think maybe you're screwing around.

raw: [name="Scout"]  She may very well be mocking you.
speaker: Scout
content: She may very well be mocking you.

raw: When he goes two days without shaving, he'll definitely look way more senior.
content: When he goes two days without shaving, he'll definitely look way more senior.

speaker: Rosmontis
content: Ace's beard is very manly.

raw: Hahaha! I have to go move some stuff around. Got my own job to do, you know. Later.
content: Hahaha! I have to go move some stuff around. Got my own job to do, you know. Later.

raw: Let's get a drink when I'm done!
content: Let's get a drink when I'm done!

raw: [name="Scout"]  Try not to puke this time.
speaker: Scout
content: Try not to puke this time.

raw: [name="Scout"]  Misery spent two hours scrubbing the floor. I wager he would vomit himself when faced with that task again.
speaker: Scout
content: Misery spent two hours scrubbing the floor. I wager he would vomit himself when faced with that task again.

raw: Who knew you could hold your liquor so well!
content: Who knew you could hold your liquor so well!

raw: Rosmontis, Mechanist will give you back your terminal in a bit.
content: Rosmontis, Mechanist will give you back your terminal in a bit.

raw: Be a good girl and wait patiently. But don't forget either!
content: Be a good girl and wait patiently. But don't forget either!

speaker: Rosmontis
content: I'll definitely remember! Bye bye!

speaker: Scout
content: Don't burn yourself!

raw: Relax. I can control my own Arts.
content: Relax. I can control my own Arts.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  ...How is it you went before me?
speaker: Blaze
content: ...How is it you went before me?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Ace, was some uninfected girl like GreyThroat really worth training?
speaker: Blaze
content: Ace, was some uninfected girl like GreyThroat really worth training?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  How much trust did we earn? And how much trust did we give?
speaker: Blaze
content: How much trust did we earn? And how much trust did we give?

speaker: Blaze
content: If the Doctor...

raw: [Decision(options="What are you saying over there?!;......;If I don't believe in Rhodes Island...?", values="1;2;3")]
options: What are you saying over there?!;......;If I don't believe in Rhodes Island...?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I'm saying bad things about you. To your face.
speaker: Blaze
content: I'm saying bad things about you. To your face.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  If there's a Doctor hanging around here, hurry up and come out already. You'll need some fancy Arts to hide behind that wall if you don't want me to find you.
speaker: Blaze
content: If there's a Doctor hanging around here, hurry up and come out already. You'll need some fancy Arts to hide behind that wall if you don't want me to find you.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Then I'll string you up on a lamppost as bait for Reunion. Don't worry! You won't die. A few bolts and a knife or two never hurt anyone.
speaker: Blaze
content: Then I'll string you up on a lamppost as bait for Reunion. Don't worry! You won't die. A few bolts and a knife or two never hurt anyone.

speaker: Blaze
content: ....sigh.

speaker: Blaze
content: Sigh!

speaker: Blaze
content: Did Amiya send you?

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Whatever. That's what she's best at. And what she's worst at...
speaker: Blaze
content: Whatever. That's what she's best at. And what she's worst at...

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I keep trying to remind her, to get her thinking about how she's still just a kid... it always seems to have the opposite effect.
speaker: Blaze
content: I keep trying to remind her, to get her thinking about how she's still just a kid... it always seems to have the opposite effect.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  I guess she'll never be able to put down that grown up persona of hers as long as she's the leader of Rhodes Island.
speaker: Blaze
content: I guess she'll never be able to put down that grown up persona of hers as long as she's the leader of Rhodes Island.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Of course, if it wasn't Amiya who sent you, if you decided to come keep me company all by yourself, I'm not against the idea.
speaker: Blaze
content: Of course, if it wasn't Amiya who sent you, if you decided to come keep me company all by yourself, I'm not against the idea.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  ...Hold me back? Haha! I could carry three of you on my back and I wouldn't even notice. One little Dr. {@nickname} can't hold me back.
speaker: Blaze
content: ...Hold me back? Haha! I could carry three of you on my back and I wouldn't even notice. One little Dr. {@nickname} can't hold me back.

speaker: Blaze
content: Hey, look over there.

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Go on! Get out of here! We don't want to fight!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Go on! Get out of here! We don't want to fight!

raw: [name="L. G. D. Officer"]  Hmph... we won't yield to the Infected!
speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Hmph... we won't yield to the Infected!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  You're outnumbered! What's the point?
speaker: Reunion Member
content: You're outnumbered! What's the point?

speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: Duty!

raw: [name="Reunion Member"]  Don't blame us for what happens! You see those monsters behind us? Just run already!
speaker: Reunion Member
content: Don't blame us for what happens! You see those monsters behind us? Just run already!

speaker: L. G. D. Officer
content: What monsters?!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  See that Reunion group cutting through the alleys? They're picking at Lungmen's vanguard units. They won't hold for long...
speaker: Blaze
content: See that Reunion group cutting through the alleys? They're picking at Lungmen's vanguard units. They won't hold for long...

speaker: Blaze
content: Give me a path.

speaker: Blaze
content: The fastest, of course!

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Don't give me that look. It's not like I've never carried you before.
speaker: Blaze
content: Don't give me that look. It's not like I've never carried you before.

raw: [name="Blaze"]  Here we go! Smash Reunion and save the Lungmenites!
speaker: Blaze
content: Here we go! Smash Reunion and save the Lungmenites!
